milestones.name: Jerusalem
milestones.introText: Jerusalem, the city of the temple, where the church was born at Pentecost and the journey of the gospel begins.

milestones.name: Caesarea
milestones.introText: Caesarea Maritima, Herod's great harbor on the Mediterranean, gateway between Judea and the wider Roman world.

milestones.name: Antioch
milestones.introText: Antioch on the Orontes, third city of the empire, where believers were first called Christians and missionaries were first sent out.

milestones.name: Rome
milestones.introText: Rome, heart of the empire. All roads lead here, and so does the gospel.

routes.name: Coastal Route
routes.description: Four successes required. Easier challenges, primarily listening and general Bible knowledge.

routes.name: Inland Route
routes.description: Three successes required. Moderate Scripture and reasoning challenges.

routes.name: Mountain Route
routes.description: Two successes required. Difficult challenges with greater reward potential.

communityEvents.title: The Harbor Gathering
communityEvents.description: All teams pause at Herod's harbor for a shared challenge before the roads divide. Teams answer in turn; the room succeeds together.

communityEvents.title: The Sending Church
communityEvents.description: The church at Antioch is sending out missionaries. Teams may pledge resources to equip them; generosity earns Service, and meeting the goal blesses the whole room.

offeringOutcomes.announcement: Your gift returns to you like bread on the waters. Choose one resource.
A returning traveler shares news of the road ahead. You learn about your next stage.
Your generosity kindles boldness. Receive one Courage.
The offering becomes a feast, and every team is strengthened. Each team receives one Provision.
Your gift travels to another camp. A different team receives a clue on its next task.
The gift is set aside for the next great gathering. The next community event will carry a bonus.
The donkey carrying your gift bolts through the marketplace, scattering figs everywhere. The crowd cheers. Nothing else happens, but it was magnificent.
The gift is received quietly, and the journey continues. The act of service itself still counts.
